author: Techlore
description:
Brave just shipped Containers, and Firefox just made them native, so the profiles-vs-containers debate that split these two browsers is finally over. This video demos both features side by side in Brave 1.92 and Firefox 153, and breaks down when to use browser profiles vs container tabs for multi-account browsing, work/personal separation, and keeping your logins isolated. Whether you use Brave, Firefox, or both, here's how to actually get more out of your browser.
